root_cause: The pricing incident was prolonged by interacting failure classes across build preservation, public i18n authority, SEO utility-route semantics, material writeback closure, queue/head stability and production promotion. Several intermediate states were technically green in one layer but nonterminal overall. The durable fix is to treat terminal delivery as a composed contract: exact candidate semantics, machine-enforced regressions, protected merge, provider production identity and user-visible browser behavior.
prevention: Pricing lifecycle, plan and billing controls are a single atomic build-preservation contract across section#prijzen-pakketten and section#pakketten.
Public locale authority is the static route prefix; stale persisted locale must never runtime-translate an unprefixed public route.
Noindex authentication routes are explicit public utility destinations, valid for internal links but excluded from sitemap/indexable SEO inventory.
Queue/pending state is infrastructure scheduling, not a code defect; do not mutate a healthy exact head without concrete failed-step evidence.
Material recovery closure requires Brain learning, append-only ledger and human-readable documentation in the same lineage.
A merge or provider-ready state alone is not LIVE_BEWEZEN; require production identity plus user-visible browser interaction proof.
When production has advanced beyond the feature merge, use ancestry for feature-live proof and exact SHA equality only for exact-current-main claims.
Do not create parallel recovery authorities. Reuse canonical Production Source Snapshot and authorized Netlify transport.
failed_approaches: Preserving only section#pakketten while lifecycle and billing controls lived partly in section#prijzen-pakketten.
Using persisted bg_locale as initial locale authority on unprefixed public pages.
Treating every valid internal destination as necessarily indexable.
Checking only for the substring UTILITY_ROUTES, which falsely matched PUBLIC_UTILITY_ROUTES and skipped the runtime declaration.
Making proof-only candidate changes while exact-head checks were only queued/pending.
Treating merged or deployed as terminal before exact provider/readback and browser behavior proof.
Omitting human-readable documentation from a material recovery candidate.

evidence.note: Current main advanced after pricing proof; no pricing/i18n source change was introduced in the intervening commits.
